OFFICIAL SYLLABUS

Unit II scope from the course handout

Definition – full annealing, stress relief, recrystallisation and spheroidising; normalising, hardening and tempering of steel; isothermal transformation diagrams; cooling curves superimposed on I.T. diagrams; continuous cooling transformation (CCT) diagrams; austempering, martempering, hardenability and Jominy end-quench test; case hardening, carburising, nitriding, cyaniding and carbonitriding; flame and induction hardening; vacuum and plasma hardening; thermo-mechanical treatments; elementary ideas on sintering.

STUDY CHECKLIST

Topics listed in the academic calendar

Use this checklist with the Unit II student-notes PDF. It follows the topic sequence in the course handout.

  • Heat treatment: definition, objectives and process variables
  • Full annealing and stress-relief annealing
  • Recrystallisation and spheroidising annealing
  • Normalising, hardening and tempering
  • TTT diagrams
  • CCT diagrams
  • Austempering and martempering
  • Hardenability and Jominy end-quench test
  • Case and surface hardening; thermo-mechanical treatment; sintering
